bullets.text: Under supervision in a team capstone, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out programming-question groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to post metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
